title: Document (WYSIWYG paper)
description: A paper as ProseMirror-style JSON (ADR-0021). Only the node types below are allowed; a new node type is an explicit schema_version bump, never silent drift. Embedded questions are validated against the canonical question schema by exam_engine.document.validate_document.

settings.$comment: Per-question `space_mm` (blank working space, mm; null = default for its marks) and `ans_unit` (unit printed after the Ans: line; null = from the answer) were added with this. Paper-wide print settings (added 1.4.0). marks_placement: where each question's [n] prints; default 'answer' (beside the Ans: line).

key_options.description: How the answer key prints (1.7.0, P5). Both default to true, i.e. the pre-P5 key.

show_question.description: Repeat each question's text, figure and options above its answer; false = steps and answer only.

show_scheme.description: Print the M/A/B marking breakdown under each answer.

layout.description: 1.14.0 (EXA-142): full (default) = each question with its worked solution; compact = a school-style key: an answer grid for multiple-choice sections, then a two-column table of working with a right-aligned Ans:. show_question does not apply to compact.

time_min.description: Paper time in minutes (1.6.0); printed in the paper header.

number_from.description: The first question's number (1.12.0, EXA-134); null or absent = 1. Paper 1 Booklet B continues Booklet A's numbering (16 onwards).

section.$comment: A paper section divider (1.6.0, P4): every question after it, up to the next section, belongs to it. Question numbers continue across sections; the section's question range and marks are derived (exam_engine.document.paper_outline), only the target is authored.

marking.description: Marking margin ("Do not write in this space") beside this section's questions (1.8.0, P6a). null/absent = on for working sections (short, structured), off otherwise.

marks_placement.description: Where this section's per-question [n] prints (1.13.0, EXA-139): none (the header sentence gives the marks), beside the question, after the Ans: line, or both. null/absent = none for mcq and short sections, the paper-wide settings.marks_placement otherwise.

cover_page.$comment: The paper's cover (1.9.0, P7). At most one, and only as the first block (exam_engine.document.validate_document). Replaces the student paper's header and ends with a page break; never printed in the answer key. Time comes from settings.time_min, the total and the examiner's table from the questions (paper_outline), so neither can drift.

instructions.description: Instructions to candidates, one per line; printed as a numbered list. A word written NOT in capitals prints bold and underlined, as on real covers (EXA-140).

examiner_table.description: Print the 'For examiner's use' marks table with diagonal-split score cells. For an exam-set paper (paper_part) it is the set's rows: Booklet A alone; Booklet A, Booklet B and the Paper 1 total; Paper 1, Paper 2 and the total out of 100 (the other papers' maxima are the standard ones from the paper templates). Otherwise one row per section with questions, then the total. null/absent = on.

parent_signature.description: Print a 'Parent's signature' line (1.15.0, EXA-140). null/absent = off.

even_pages.description: Pad the printed booklet to an even page count with a blank last page (1.15.0, EXA-140). null/absent = off.

blank_page.$comment: A page of its own (1.9.0, P7): 'blank' prints 'This page is intentionally left blank.' in the middle, 'rough' prints a 'Rough work' heading over an empty page. `text` replaces the default wording. Never printed in the answer key; carries no tally box.

question.description: Frozen snapshot of a canonical question object (validated by the canonical schema).

in_key.description: false leaves this question out of the answer key (1.7.0); absent = included.

locked.description: true keeps this question when the paper is regenerated, and blocks swapping it (1.11.0, P8d); absent = unlocked.

in_key.description: false leaves this question out of the answer key (1.7.0); absent = included.

locked.description: true keeps this question when the paper is regenerated, and blocks swapping it (1.11.0, P8d); absent = unlocked.

content.$comment: The body (text blocks), then optionally the parts (a), (b)... (added 1.5.0). Parts come last and at most 10; with parts, the marks live on the parts and the question-level marks/answer are unused. Order and limits are enforced by exam_engine.document.validate_document.

freeform_part.$comment: One lettered part of a multi-part free-form question. The label (a), (b)... is its position, never stored.

slot.$comment: What the paper generator asked for at this position (1.10.0, P8a): the slot's marks and kind; stand_in = a single-part question standing in for a multi-part one; placeholder = left for the teacher to write (a free-form question). Informational: printing ignores it.

remark.description: The author's private note on a question (1.3.0). Shown in the inspector only; never rendered into any preview or export.
